title: Product of Array Except Self
prompt:
Return an array `answer` where `answer[i]` is the product of every element of `nums` **except** `nums[i]`. Solve it in O(n) **without division**.

**Example**: `[1,2,3,4]` → `[24,12,8,6]`.

The trick: `answer[i]` = (product of everything to the left) × (product of everything to the right). Two sweeps, no division.
hints: First pass left→right: res[i] = product of everything before i.
Second pass right→left: multiply res[i] by a running product of everything after i.
Keep the running right-product in a single variable so you use O(1) extra space.

solution.explanation: O(n) time, O(1) extra space (the output array doesn't count). res[i] first holds the prefix product, then gets multiplied by the suffix product accumulated in `right`. Avoiding division is what makes the zero cases (which would divide by zero) work cleanly.
